name: @qdnbd/dsh-panel-pins
description: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a Panels launcher that groups global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one searchable menu (Ctrl+K command palette, per-group collapsible memory, search-hit highlighting, Alt+1..9 direct activation of the Nth visible item), persistent pin/unpin with hover quick-actions, top-pinning of chosen panels, right-click context menu on sidebar rows, icon-only panel-row mode, a scrollable capped panel list, a toggleable compact footer with granular sub-toggles, and a full Settings page (toggles, height sliders, keep-in-sidebar whitelist, drag-to-reorder pin management, settings export/import).
author: QDNBD
